decision.explanation: The documents present two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding Jay Morris's current position. Document Set 1 (D1) consistently asserts he serves as a 'Member of the Louisiana House of Representatives' (supported by D1S1, D1S2, D1S14). Document Set 2 (D2) asserts he has taken the oath as an 'Irish Senator' (supported by D2S1, D2S2, D2S3). Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat audits as fallible, both claims are retained as valid answers derived from the provided source text, despite the logical impossibility of them being simultaneously true in reality.
